description:
# EssentialsZ

A modular Nukkit (Bedrock Edition) plugin with essential server features - 18 modules, 44 commands

--- ## Features | Module | Commands | Description | |--------|----------|-------------| | **Home** | /home, /sethome | Set and teleport to homes | | **TPA** | /tpa, /tpahere, /tpaccept, /tpdeny | Teleport request system | | **Warp** | /warp, /setwarp, /delwarp, /warps | Server warps | | **RTP** | /rtp | Random teleport | | **Spawn** | /spawn, /setspawn | Join/respawn spawn | | **Kits** | /kit, /createkit, /delkit | Item kits with cooldowns | | **Moderation** | /mute, /unmute, /warn, /warnings | Moderation tools | | **Economy** | /bal, /pay, /baltop, /eco | Balance and economy | | **Jobs** | /jobs, /job join/leave | Earn money for activities | | **Vote** | /vote, /voteclaim, /votetop | Vote rewards | | **Backpack** | /backpack | Personal storage | | **DailyRewards** | /daily | Daily login rewards | | **Sell** | /sell hand, /sell all | Sell items to server | | **AuctionHouse** | /ah, /ah sell, /ah buy | Player-to-player trading | | **GodMode** | /god | Toggle invincibility | | **Fly** | /fly | Toggle flight | | **PlayerWarps** | /pwarp | Player-made warps | | **ChatFormat** | /setprefix, /setsuffix | Chat prefix/suffix system | ## Installation

### Quick Install 1. Download `EssentialsZ-1.1.4.jar` from [Releases](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/releases) 2. Drop into `plugins/` folder 3. Restart server ### Detailed Guides - [Windows Installation](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/install/windows.md) - [Linux Installation](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/install/linux.md) - [macOS Installation](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/install/macos.md) ## Configuration Edit `plugins/EssentialsZ/config.yml` to enable/disable modules: ```yaml modules: home: enabled: true tpa: enabled: true economy: enabled: true godmode: enabled: true fly: enabled: true playerwarps: enabled: true chatformat: enabled: true # ... etc ``` ### Vote Configuration Edit `plugins/EssentialsZ/vote.yml` to add your server's voting sites: ```yaml sites: - name: "TopG" url: "https://topg.org/Minecraft-Server-YOUR_SERVER_ID" enabled: true reward: 100.0 ``` See [Vote Setup Guide](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/issues/voting.md) for detailed instructions. ## Building

### Quick Build ```bash git clone https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ.git cd EssentialsZ mvn clean package ``` ### Build Guides - [Windows Build](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/build/windows.md) - [Linux Build](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/build/linux.md) - [macOS Build](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/build/macos.md) ## Documentation - [Installation Guide](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/install/README.md) - [Build Guide](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/build/README.md) - [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/issues/README.md) - [Voting Setup](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/docs/issues/voting.md) ## Requirements - [Nukkit-MOT](https://github.com/MemoriesOfTime/Nukkit-MOT) 1.20.50+ - Java 17+ ## License - [LICENSE](https://github.com/Dev-Studio95/EssentialsZ/blob/main/LICENSE)

## EssentialsZ v1.1.2

### Bug Fix (Critical)
- **economy.yml unquoted integer keys**: Nukkit-MOT's Config class extends HashMap<String, Object>. When SnakeYAML parses unquoted numeric keys (264:, 56:), it creates Integer objects internally. Config tries to cast these to String keys, causing ClassCastException before plugin code even runs.
- This was the root cause of Economy, Jobs, Vote, DailyRewards, and AuctionHouse all failing to enable.
- Fix: all numeric keys in economy.yml are now quoted ("264": 250.0)

### 18 Modules, 47 Commands
All modules now load cleanly.

### Installation
1. Download EssentialsZ-1.1.2.jar
2. Drop into plugins/
3. Restart server
4. Delete plugins/EssentialsZ/economy.yml if upgrading from older version

## EssentialsZ v1.1.1

### Bug Fix
- **EconomyService ClassCastException**: SnakeYAML parses numeric YAML keys (264:, 277:) as Integer, but loadPrices() cast to Map<String, Object> causing ClassCastException
- This cascaded to Jobs, Vote, DailyRewards, AuctionHouse which all depend on EconomyService
- getTopBalances() also used unsafe getSection().getAll() cast

### 18 Modules, 47 Commands
All modules now load cleanly on Nukkit-MOT.

### Installation
1. Download EssentialsZ-1.1.1.jar
2. Drop into plugins/
3. Restart server

versions.changelog:
## EssentialsZ v1.1.0

### New Modules (4)
- **GodMode** - /god [player] - toggle invincibility, persistent across logouts
- **Fly** - /fly [player] - toggle flight, clears on logout
- **PlayerWarps** - /pwarp create/remove/list/tp - player-made warps
- **ChatFormat** - /setprefix, /setsuffix - configurable chat prefixes/suffixes

### Bug Fixes (7)
- TeleportDelay: fixed cancelTask using tick counter as task ID
- AhGui: fixed null player listener registration + page tracking
- AuctionHouse: now uses shared EconomyService, reads config values
- SpawnListener: respects spawn-on-join and spawn-on-respawn config
- ChatFormatListener: properly broadcasts formatted chat
- economy.yml: fixed duplicate item IDs
- FlyCommand: fixed for MOT API compatibility

### 18 Modules, 47 Commands
Home | TPA | Warp | RTP | Spawn | Kits | Moderation | Economy | Jobs | Vote | Backpack | DailyRewards | Sell | AuctionHouse | GodMode | Fly | PlayerWarps | ChatFormat

### Installation
1. Download EssentialsZ-1.1.0.jar
2. Drop into plugins/
3. Restart server
